output.explanation:
The central tree retains the six main component boundaries while shrinking from 115 to 79 lines (31.3%) and from 8,974 to 6,147 characters (31.5%). Five connected peripheral trees expand selection, storage, cache ownership, pane/rendering behavior, and language-session lifetimes. [M] means modular structure, [C] source-described calls/control flow, [O] ownership, and [D] data dependency; these are not observed runtime traces. Positions account for measured text dimensions and leave gaps between all diagrams.

Corrections and qualifications: SourceCodePane.tsx shows that mapped-range reveal bypasses navigate() and leaves history unchanged. corpus.ts permits an empty directory path for the root; it rejects empty segments within nonempty paths. Symlinks can appear in listings as files, although access through them is rejected. sourceFileCache.ts prioritizes pending work without preempting running loads. projectLanguageService.ts owns sessions per service instance, so application-wide singleton sharing is not established.

Added source-grounded details include binding conflict checks omitting revision (diagramSource.ts), EOF clipping and current-filesystem reads regardless of binding.revision (corpus.ts), repository ID derivation and comparisonBase handling (repositoryRegistry.ts), uncancelled cache replacements and absent eviction limits (sourceFileCache.ts), bounded visit history and measured 80-row rendering chunks (SourceCodePane.tsx and SourceCodeView.tsx), and language-server encoding negotiation and process cleanup (projectLanguageService.ts).

Only context.json and seed.json supplied evidence. Imported implementations such as sourceFilesClient and resolveNodeResources are absent: their internal wiring, transport cancellation behavior, and mapping traversal rules remain unspecified. Aborting the pane's read signal is therefore not presented as proof that a shared underlying load stops.

diagrams.ascii:
[M] Repository Evidence and Navigation
|-- [M] Source selection boundary: resolveDiagramSource
|   |-- Depends on project/catalog persistence + optional CorpusAccess
|   |-- [C] Load project -> require matching projectId -> resolve diagram
|   |   |-- representationId -> validate representation and revision membership
|   |   |-- Live diagram -> validate diagram and optional contentId match
|   |   |-- Saved representation -> sceneFromRevision -> select one diagram
|   |   `-- Otherwise -> combine saved bindings + project.sources; require one source
|   |-- Supplied sourceId must match the selected diagram's binding
|   `-- Exposes diagramSource query + diagram + binding() + readText() + listFiles()
|       `-- Reads/listings need a binding and CorpusAccess.provider(binding.corpus)
|-- [M] Mapping interpretation: selected diagram nodes -> source resources
|   |-- Public: handleNodeSelect, resolveSelectedNodes, buildSourceRangeDisplayModel
|   |-- Internal source-range index; domain handlers have no React or file I/O
|   |   |-- Reject mappings when sourceContext.contentHash != content.asciiSha256
|   |   `-- [D] diagramSource.entries() -> entity + evidence range + binding
|   |       |-- Resource: projectId, entity/binding sourceId, path, inclusive 1-based lines
|   |       `-- rangeSha256 = SHA-256(originalLines joined with LF)
|   |-- [C] Sort selected nodes by diagram position -> resolveNodeResources
|   |   `-- Attach selected/mapped origins -> deduplicate by repository/path/range/hash
|   |       `-- Retain all origins, selected/unmapped node IDs and diagram identity
|   `-- Display grouping preserves diagram order
|       |-- New section when repository/file changes or source lines move backwards
|       `-- Merge overlapping ranges within the current section; retain contributing items
|-- [M] Source application service: ProjectSourceService
|   |-- [C] files(projectId, directory, sourceId?) -> resolve source -> listFiles
|   |-- [C] source(projectId, path, sourceId?) -> require path -> resolve -> readText
|   |   |-- NUL in text -> binary-source error
|   |   `-- [D] Text -> lines + SHA-256 + path + startLine=1 + lspEnabled
|   `-- [C] definitions(reference, path, position, sourceSha256, signal)
|       |-- No injected language service -> lsp-disabled error
|       `-- Resolve source -> language.definitions(binding.corpus, anchor, signal)
|-- [M] Storage adapters: corpus reads and Git identity have distinct contracts
|   |-- CorpusAccess / CorpusProvider
|   |   |-- Public: listDirectory, readLines; readable extension adds bytes/text/lines
|   |   |-- git-worktree and filesystem-documents both read the canonical filesystem root
|   |   |-- Internal checks: relative paths, no symlink traversal, containment and type
|   |   `-- Listings hide .git and sort directories first; evidence reads validate ranges
|   `-- GitRepositoryRegistry
|       |-- Public: list/register, resolveCheckoutRoot, resolveContext, captureHunks
|       |-- [D] Discovered Git identity -> stable repository ID + merged checkout roots
|       |-- [C] Resolve matching checkout -> resolve head/commits/optional base to SHAs
|       `-- [O] Persist registry in project.json; shared per-file queue serializes updates
|-- [M] Browser access and source presentation
|   |-- CodeRepoService: explicit {projectId, sourceId} on repository operations
|   |   |-- Contract: read/preload, directory, search, definitions and Git operations
|   |   |-- Positions: zero-based UTF-16; Git diff hunk lines: one-based
|   |   `-- HTTP adapter -> sourceFilesClient + directory/definition API helpers
|   |       `-- Search and every Git operation reject as unsupported
|   |-- [O] SourceFileCache owns shared read promises and a bounded work queue
|   |   |-- Identity = projectId + sourceId + path; compatible versions reuse promises
|   |   |-- Reload/version mismatch -> new read; default concurrency = 4
|   |   `-- Pending on-demand work gets priority; failed current entries are evicted
|   `-- SourceCodePane -> CodeRepoService + SourceCodeView
|       |-- [C] File selection/reload -> readFile -> preview or retryable error
|       |-- [D] Loaded/projected hash mismatch -> disable mapped highlights and compaction
|       |-- [C] File/definition navigation -> capture visit -> history -> patch location
|       |   `-- Mapped-range reveal resets scroll and target without adding history
|       |-- [O] Pane retains preview, history, navigation and request controllers
|       |   `-- Cleanup aborts read signal; definition requests abort on context/navigation
|       `-- SourceCodeView renders read-only text through presentation options
|           |-- Source + path + theme -> tokens; failure -> original source text
|           |-- Ranges + compaction sections -> highlights, folds and expandable nodes
|           |-- [O] Owns expansion state; ignores obsolete tokenization results
|           |-- Bound scroll state survives hidden views without zero-offset overwrite
|           `-- Ctrl/Cmd+click or F12 -> source position -> pane definition callback
`-- [M] Optional definition engine: ProjectLanguageService
    |-- Public definitions(binding, file, position, sourceSha256, signal) and dispose()
    |-- [C] Validate supported TS/JS path and nonnegative integer UTF-16 position
    |   `-- Read current corpus text -> compare SHA-256 -> validate position within text
    |       `-- Canonicalize root -> get/create session -> queued definition lookup
    |-- [D] Current text + matching hash + position + language response -> definitions
    |   |-- Normalize locations/links; retain repository-relative file targets
    |   `-- Deduplicate locations; count excluded targets as outsideRoot
    |       `-- Pane: one result -> navigate; multiple -> chooser; none -> message
    `-- [O] One lazy session per canonical root within each service instance
        |-- Session owns child process, JSON-RPC connection, serial queue and timers
        |-- AbortSignal cancels active RPC; timeout or child/RPC failure disposes session
        `-- Idle/service shutdown disposes resources; later lookup can replace dead session

[C] Resolve a source without assuming one repository
|-- Project must exist and match ref.projectId
|-- representationId present: validate before using live/saved content
|   |-- revisionId defaults to representation.currentRevisionId
|   `-- Representation must contain that revisionId
|-- Content choice, in precedence order
|   |-- liveDiagram -> validateDiagram; check contentId if supplied
|   |-- Saved revision -> sceneFromRevision -> filter contents
|   |   `-- Match contentId, else bound diagrams; require exactly one
|   `-- Neither -> load saved bindings, then project.sources
|       |-- Optional sourceId filter; Map deduplicates by sourceId
|       |-- Same ID: root, kind or repositoryIdentity differs -> error
|       |-- Revision is not part of this conflict comparison
|       `-- Exactly one -> temporary source-query diagram, revision 0
`-- Returned query has lazy access checks
    |-- Supplied sourceId must match diagram.sourceContext.binding
    |-- binding() throws if the selected diagram has no binding
    `-- readText/listFiles additionally require injected CorpusAccess

[M] Storage boundaries and identities
|-- Corpus provider: filesystem access selected by binding.kind
|   |-- Canonicalize binding.root; require matching kind and a directory
|   |-- Empty directory path is valid: it denotes the corpus root
|   |-- Reject absolute paths, NUL, backslash, '.', '..', empty segments
|   |-- lstat each descendant segment -> reject symbolic links
|   |-- Listing hides .git; symlinks can appear as files but cannot be read
|   |-- readLines validates integer, ordered, positive line numbers
|   |   `-- End beyond EOF is clipped; start beyond EOF yields []
|   `-- git-worktree reads current files; binding.revision is not consulted
`-- GitRepositoryRegistry: identity and checkout availability
    |-- [D] ID = 'repo-' + first 24 hex characters of SHA-256(identity)
    |-- initialize only backfills when project.repositories is undefined
    |   `-- Discover configured checkout + Git source roots; skip failures
    |-- register merges roots; explicit nonblank name wins over prior name
    |-- availableRoot tries saved roots, then configured checkout
    |   `-- A discovered root must have the registered repository identity
    |-- resolveContext requires ID unless exactly one repository exists
    |   |-- head defaults to HEAD; rev-parse verifies commit objects
    |   |-- Repeated refs reuse local resolution; commit SHAs deduplicate
    |   `-- comparisonBase preserves omitted vs null vs resolved SHA
    `-- [O] Module-level queue keyed by project.json path
        |-- Failed predecessor does not block the next operation
        `-- Completion removes queue entry only if it is still current

[O] SourceFileCache: promises and scheduling
|-- Key = JSON(projectId, sourceId, path)
|-- Reuse requires !reload and an existing entry
|   |-- Compatible if either version is absent/falsy, or versions match
|   |-- Missing cached version is filled with request version via ??=
|   `-- On-demand reuse moves matching queued job to the front
|-- New entry replaces map value with a new promise
|   |-- Entry version = request.version ?? previous.version
|   |-- Background job -> queue tail; on-demand job -> queue front
|   `-- Old queued/running jobs are not cancelled by replacement
|-- drain starts work while active < concurrency (default 4)
|   |-- Queue priority affects pending jobs; active loads keep running
|   `-- finally decrements active and drains again
|-- Failure rejects that promise
|   `-- Evict only if map still points to the failed entry
`-- preload schedules background reads and consumes their errors
    |-- Successful promises remain cached; no size/age eviction shown
    `-- Loader accepts SourceFileRequest; this class has no AbortSignal

[C/O] Pane navigation and rendering
|-- SourceCodePane owns visits, preview and request controllers
|   |-- navigate captures current path/range/scroll
|   |   |-- Fresh visit keeps last 99 back entries + current; clears forward
|   |   `-- Back/forward transfers current visit to the opposite stack
|   |-- reveal resets pane scroll, clears navigation, patches rangeIndex
|   |   `-- Increments revealRequestId; leaves visit history unchanged
|   |-- Read-effect cleanup aborts signal; completion checks it before setState
|   `-- Definition cleanup runs on project/source/file/active changes
|-- [D] Loaded hash vs projected hash determines mapped presentation
|   |-- Mismatch -> empty highlights, no compaction, mapped controls disabled
|   `-- Definition lookup still uses loaded hash if LSP/path are supported
`-- SourceCodeView owns folds, token state and DOM scroll handling
    |-- Plain presentation skips tokenization; failed tokens fall back to text
    |-- Only ordered collapsed-comment ranges inside preview become sections
    |-- Navigation target opens its containing fold; graph expansions reset
    |-- Fold can show a gap button or annotated graph with node expansion
    |-- Bound scroll wins over initial scroll; otherwise reveal target line
    |   `-- Destination selection is reapplied after tokenization replaces nodes
    `-- SourceCodeContent defers offscreen layout when enabled and unwrapped
        |-- More than 240 rendered rows -> chunks of 80 rows
        |-- Measure chunks before content-visibility:auto; retain intrinsic sizes
        |-- Native search/selection retain mounted content
        `-- Width changes trigger remeasurement; cleanup disconnects observer

[O/C] LanguageSession lifetime and lookup
|-- ProjectLanguageService owns a Map keyed by canonical root
|   |-- Create lazily; replace missing/dead session on lookup
|   `-- Service dispose clears Map and prevents future lookups
|-- Session owns typescript-language-server child + JSON-RPC connection
|   |-- Initialize with UTF-16, definition link support and workspace root
|   |-- Require definitionProvider; absent positionEncoding is accepted
|   |-- Reject an explicitly different encoding; refuse workspace edits
|   `-- Initialization bounded to 20 seconds; failure disposes session
|-- lookup appends work to a serial promise queue
|   |-- Wait for ready -> check dead/abort -> didOpen(current text)
|   |-- definition RPC gets a cancellation token and 20-second bound
|   |-- finally removes abort listener and disposes token
|   |   `-- didClose is sent only while session is alive
|   `-- Failed request does not poison the queue for later work
|-- Idle timer: 5 minutes, refreshed after initialization/lookup
|-- Dispose on timeout, child error/exit, RPC error or service disposal
|   |-- Mark dead; remove from liveSessions; clear timer; dispose RPC
|   `-- SIGTERM child PID on Windows, process group elsewhere
`-- Module tracks live sessions for SIGINT/SIGTERM cleanup
    |-- Process exit hook also disposes each service's sessions
    `-- UI sharing is per service instance; singleton wiring is not supplied
